english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when “madness” means mental illness or insanity.

exampleSentences.english: They have madness and need to be hospitalized.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢有精神病，要入院治療。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 zing1 san4 beng6 jiu3 jap6 jyun2 zi6 liu4

english.note: Use this for a serious mental illness or disorder.

exampleSentences.english: He has a serious mental disturbance and needs treatment.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢有精神病，需要接受治療。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 zing1 san4 beng6 seoi1 jiu3 zip3 sau6 zi6 liu4
